title: Viral Video Of Lakers' Anthony Davis Kidnapping Warriors' Steph Curry On GTA Resurfaces [Watch]
htmlContent:
The Los Angeles Lakers and Golden State Warriors are two of the most storied franchises in NBA history, and their matchups have always been must-see TV. In the 2023 Western Conference semifinals, these two teams will once again face off in what promises to be an epic battle. Both teams are stacked with talent and have a deep roster, making this series one that is sure to go down to the wire.

The Lakers will come into this series with a renewed sense of confidence, as they look to make a deep playoff run after a disappointing season in 2022. Led by LeBron James and Anthony Davis, the Lakers have one of the most formidable duos in the league. Their supporting cast is also top-notch, with players like Malik Beasley, Dennis Schröder, and D'Angelo Russell providing depth and experience. The Lakers will need all hands on deck if they hope to get past the Warriors, as Golden State boasts a talented roster of their own.

With Stephen Curry leading the way and a supporting cast that includes Klay Thompson, Draymond Green, and Andrew Wiggins, the Warriors will be a tough out for any team in the playoffs. However, the Lakers have the talent and experience to match up well with Golden State, and this series should be one for the ages.

Speaking of this upcoming series between the Lakers and Warriors, a video of Anthony Davis kidnapping Steph Curry on GTA resurfaces.

On Instagram a user by name of Hoops Hall post the video with the caption that reads,

Never forget when Anthony Davis kidnapped Steph Curry in GTA and shot him off the edge of a cliff

“‘We ain’t playing with ni**as bro!’ [Shoots Steph]. We out!”
